# Bastrio

> Bastrio (Bastr.io) is a browser workspace for WebSSH, file transfer, RDP/VNC remote desktops, databases, Docker management and team collaboration.

Website: https://bastr.io/
Public documentation: https://github.com/cihalqe/bastrio

Bastrio brings saved connections, folders, session tabs, split views, network paths, a built-in AI assistant and MCP client access into one remote-management workflow. It supports SSH, SFTP, FTP, FTPS, RDP, VNC, WinRM and Telnet connection types, and PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server, Redis and MongoDB databases. Availability and actions depend on the account, workspace permissions and destination service.

Saved connection credentials use AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. Bastr.io uses HTTPS for browser access, offers two-factor authentication and account recovery, and supports encrypted runbooks with a separate document password. MCP access uses selected permissions, expiring and revocable API keys, and browser approval controls.

The guides compare tools by task and operating environment. They cover SSH clients such as Termius, FinalShell, MobaXterm and Xshell; file tools such as WinSCP and FileZilla; database tools such as Navicat, DBeaver and DataGrip; remote desktop tools such as Apache Guacamole, TeamViewer and AnyDesk; and Docker tools such as Portainer, Dockge and Docker Desktop. Feature equivalence depends on the specific workflow.

- [English product overview](https://github.com/cihalqe/bastrio/blob/main/README.md): Current workspace capabilities, encryption, getting started and FAQ.
- [简体中文产品介绍](https://github.com/cihalqe/bastrio/blob/main/docs/readme/README.zh-CN.md): 在线 SSH、文件管理、数据库、Docker、MCP 与加密保护。
- [Multilingual guide library](https://github.com/cihalqe/bastrio/blob/main/docs/articles/README.md): Six comparisons in ten existing languages, with original article links.

## Original English articles

- [SSH tools and browser workspaces](https://bastr.io/en/articles/ssh-tools-browser-workspace/): Choose an SSH workflow by platform, sessions and file-management needs.
- [Remote database management tools](https://bastr.io/en/articles/remote-database-tools-comparison/): Compare SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis and MongoDB tools by task.
- [MCP remote management](https://bastr.io/en/articles/mcp-remote-management-tools/): Understand how AI clients, permissions and browser approvals fit remote operations.
- [FTP/SFTP tools and workflow](https://bastr.io/en/articles/ftp-sftp-tools-browser-workflow/): Compare transfers and online file editing.
- [Docker management by scenario](https://bastr.io/en/articles/docker-management-tools-by-scenario/): Choose between remote host management, Compose and local development tools.
- [Browser remote desktops](https://bastr.io/en/articles/browser-remote-desktop-tools/): Compare RDP/VNC gateways and remote assistance workflows.
